text: Given an api-key-authenticated call with header X-Run-Origin: task hits PUT /api/agents/:id/connectors/:cid/tools (mb-platform-agent, the route code-comments as "MCP: set_connector_tools"), When it tries to enable or disable a tool, Then the request is refused with the fixed message "This agent's configuration can't be changed during a triggered run" and the connector's allowedTools/disabledTools in .mcp.json are unchanged.
tests: service/aegra/run-origin-guard.test.ts: an api-key caller with a production origin is refused with the fixed message
evidence: service/capability/route.ts:328-339 calls requireNonProductionOrigin(c) before requireAgentAccess/updateAgentTools, so a non-exempt origin returns the fixed message and updateAgentTools() never runs (verified by construction + source pin). Guard predicate itself verified in service/aegra/run-origin-guard.test.ts ('an api-key caller with a production origin is refused with the fixed message', pass). Full command: `node --test service/capability/route-run-origin-guard.test.ts service/aegra/run-origin-guard.test.ts` -> 13 passed, 0 failed.

text: Given the same route called by a normal (non-api-key, session-authenticated) request from the SOP Author's Connector Tools panel, When a human toggles a tool switch, Then the write succeeds exactly as today (no regression for the builder UI).
tests: service/aegra/run-origin-guard.test.ts: a normal session-authenticated caller (no api-key grant) is never gated, any origin
evidence: requireNonProductionOrigin() returns null unconditionally when hasApiKeyGrant() is false (service/aegra/run-origin-guard.ts:40) -- a normal session-authenticated SOP Author UI request never enters runWithApiKeyGrant (service/common/route.ts's applyApiKeyPolicy only grants it to a route that both opted in AND verified an api-key token), so this route's existing requireAgentAccess()+updateAgentTools() path is reached unchanged. Verified directly in service/aegra/run-origin-guard.test.ts ('a normal session-authenticated caller (no api-key grant) is never gated, any origin', pass).

text: Given mspbots-agent-mcp's mspbotsagent_upsert_agent_permissions is invoked during a run whose origin is anything other than chat/build (e.g. a schedule-triggered run, origin=cron), When it tries to change permission/interrupt_on/owners, Then mb-platform-agent's shared PUT /api/agents/:id refuses the write and the tool call returns the fixed refusal error; the agent's permissions are unchanged afterward.
evidence: service/agent/route.ts:542-546 (updateAgent, backing PUT /api/agents/:id) calls requireNonProductionOrigin(c) and returns fail(...) before any patch is applied. Source pin: service/agent/route-run-origin-guard.test.ts, pass. Refusal-for-non-exempt-origin logic: service/aegra/run-origin-guard.test.ts, pass.

text: Given a task-origin run, When mspbotsagent_run_trigger is called (it executes an existing trigger, it does not change configuration), Then the call is NOT refused -- confirms the gate only covers configuration-changing routes, not every mspbotsagent_* tool.

evidence: runTask (POST /api/tasks/:id/run, backing mspbotsagent_run_trigger) contains no call to requireNonProductionOrigin -- confirmed by a negative source pin (assert.doesNotMatch) in service/task/route-run-origin-guard.test.ts, pass.

text: Given a connector tool was disabled by a person via the SOP Author Connector Tools panel (chat/build-origin write, succeeds per TC2), When a later task-origin run calls the connector-tools route to re-enable that same tool, Then the call is refused and the tool is still disabled on the agent's next .mcp.json sync.
evidence: By construction: the connector-tools route returns the refusal (service/capability/route.ts:331-333) strictly before calling updateAgentTools() (the only function that mutates .mcp.json's allowedTools/disabledTools), so a refused re-enable attempt cannot change persisted state -- same source pin as TC1. The human-disable half of this case (TC2, chat/build path) is pre-existing, unaffected route behavior. Full live round trip (disable as a human, then attempt re-enable from a real triggered run, then read back .mcp.json) was not executed against a live server: this sandbox's dist/server.js cannot boot (AI_GATEWAY_URL is not set in the shared .env, a pre-existing gap -- see Self-test) and local API routes have no path to real session auth either way (see qa-execution.md's local-auth blind spot). Logged as a local blind spot, not a failure.

tests: service/aegra/run-origin-guard.test.ts: an api-key caller with origin=build is allowed (TC12)
evidence: requireNonProductionOrigin() returns null for origin=build even with an api-key grant (service/aegra/run-origin-guard.ts:41-42), so set_sop_purpose/upsert_agent_permissions calls made from the SOP Author builder session (origin=build, per the Current state entry-point table) reach their existing handlers unchanged. Verified directly: service/aegra/run-origin-guard.test.ts 'an api-key caller with origin=build is allowed (TC12)', pass.

text: Given tenant B's api-key (X_Tenant_ID=B) and X-Run-Origin: chat calls PUT /api/agents/:id for an agent that belongs to tenant A, Then the existing per-tenant scoping (schema-per-tenant DB access) 404s/denies before the new run-origin gate is even reached -- confirms the new gate composes with, and does not weaken, existing cross-tenant isolation.
tests: service/agent/route-run-origin-guard.test.ts: updateAgent still loads the agent through the caller's own tenant-scoped getDb() (TC14)
evidence: updateAgent still calls loadAgent(id) (service/agent/route.ts:301, getDb()-scoped -- schema-per-tenant) and 404s with fail("Agent not found") when the row is absent from the caller's own tenant DB; this is unchanged by the new guard, which composes with it rather than replacing it. Source pin: service/agent/route-run-origin-guard.test.ts 'updateAgent still loads the agent through the caller's own tenant-scoped getDb() (TC14)', pass. TC14's own scenario uses X-Run-Origin: chat specifically so the new gate never intervenes, isolating the assertion to tenant scoping alone (unchanged code path) -- no live cross-tenant DB round trip was executed in this sandbox (DEV01 has no network path to the live tenant DBs, a pre-existing environment constraint, see reference_sandbox_no_network_to_live_services).

text: Given an api-key-authenticated call to a configuration-changing route arrives with NO X-Run-Origin header at all (e.g. an unpatched mspbots-agent-mcp instance, or a direct API-key call bypassing the MCP layer), Then the call is refused (fail-closed: missing/unrecognized origin is treated as a production run, not silently allowed).
tests: service/aegra/run-origin-guard.test.ts: an api-key caller with no X-Run-Origin header at all is refused -- fail-closed (TC15)
evidence: requireNonProductionOrigin() refuses when the header is absent or empty (service/aegra/run-origin-guard.ts:41-43, fail-closed default). Verified directly: service/aegra/run-origin-guard.test.ts 'an api-key caller with no X-Run-Origin header at all is refused -- fail-closed (TC15)' and '...with an empty X-Run-Origin header is refused -- fail-closed', both pass.
